bug_report: checkout(100, 0.20) returns 100 instead of 80. The discount is never applied to the amount charged.

A deactivated staff account can still export audit records when its assigned role is
admin. Active administrators should retain export access, but all actions should be
denied as soon as an account is deactivated. Other roles appear to respect the
account status correctly.
